scope: Repair application-shell UI/UX regression by moving from a generic mock dashboard to a Bominal-informed cohesive professional operator shell.
user_direction: Fix the UI/UX using visual-ralph and frontend-ui-engineering.
Current mockup was nowhere close to /Users/jasonlee/Downloads/Bominal in visual, feature, or functionality and was a major regression.
Use Bominal and Workflow Editor references without copying them verbatim; improve and integrate into a cohesive product.
implemented: Reframed the prototype as a professional operator shell with Bominal-style left product rail, sticky top command bar, breadcrumb, command palette trigger, workspace switcher, compact density, hairline borders, ink-blue accent, and flat surfaces.

Replaced oversized hero/card spacing with a dense command-center information architecture: context switcher, product surface tabs, active context banner, KPI strip, action inbox, calendar, full-width Work Hub, service catalog, Workflow Studio, object graph, and copilot/advisory rail.

Expanded visual/functionality parity for built-in Messenger/Mail/Community through integrated Work Hub tabs, thread list, item detail, local composer, local draft queueing, and static fallback behavior with no backend sends.

Moved Workflow Studio closer to the supplied workflow references: top run/status bar, palette, mode switcher, node canvas with ports/edges/minimap, inspector, status bar, local add-block and simulation-preview controls.
Added a shell command palette surface opened by the top search trigger or Cmd/Ctrl+K in the static fallback script.
Stabilized SSR dev server responsiveness by handling each TCP request on its own thread with read/write timeouts so idle gvproxy/Podman connections no longer make port 3000 appear dead.
Preserved prototype non-goals: no backend integration, no real auth/authz, no PHI/PII, no external mail/message/community send, no real workflow execution.

verification.details: HTML contains app-rail, command-palette, Workflow Studio, Messenger · Mail, and Selective WASM islands.
Port 3000 ready after restart; container oya-frontend-prototype-live remains Up with 0.0.0.0:3000->3000/tcp.

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style professional operator shell rather than generic demo dashboard
differences_remaining: This remains an Oyatie Leptos/Rust prototype and intentionally does not copy Bominal's React source, exact data model, or exact product labels.
Some advanced Bominal interactions such as real drag-to-connect workflow edges, deep command search filtering, and persisted side-peek history are visual/local-only or deferred.
visual_verdict.reasoning: Final screenshots show the major Bominal patterns now present: left rail, command bar, dense KPI/action layout, integrated Work Hub, and workflow editor chrome with palette/canvas/inspector/status. Remaining differences are intentional prototype boundaries.

non_claims: No backend integration, real authentication/authorization, real tenant data, PHI/PII, external message/mail/community send, or real workflow execution is claimed.
No production readiness, measured SLO, DR, compliance certification, provider-live operation, or hyperscaler readiness is claimed.
Bominal assets were used as reference evidence; the implementation uses repo-native Rust/Leptos/CSS/JS instead of copying the supplied React app as-is.

findings: Reduced generic AI-dashboard feel by introducing a real product shell and dense operator IA.
Kept the scope bounded to the application-shell prototype instead of scattering Bominal code across the repo.
No hyperscaler readiness claim; Podman smoke is local dev-server evidence only.
User-identified regression was accepted as a failed visual pass and corrected by inspecting Bominal.zip directly.
Anchor overlay/sticky issues were repaired with static command bar and scroll-margin offsets.
Left rail, breadcrumb, command palette, surface tabs, and denser panels make navigation and scanning closer to the reference.
Rust fmt/test/SSR/hydrate builds passed; JS syntax check passed; browser screenshots captured.
